## Scope

- [ ] Milestone/slice and explicit exclusions are stated.
- [ ] No unrelated source, schema, or deployment expansion.

## User-visible behavior

Describe the flow and degraded states. Attach desktop/mobile screenshots for UI changes.

## Data and configuration

List migrations, seed changes, new variables, rollback, and whether live ingestion is enabled (default must be no).

## Source access

List each adapter as live, fixture-only, or unavailable. Confirm CI makes no live source requests.

## Verification

Paste exact lint, typecheck, unit/integration, Playwright, migration/seed, audit, and build results.
